final: WITH matched AS (SELECT o.orderbase AS channel, f.feerate AS fee_rate FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON CAST(f.orderslink AS BLOB) = CAST(o.recordvault AS BLOB)), channel_avgs AS (SELECT channel, AVG(fee_rate) AS avg_fee_rate FROM matched GROUP BY channel), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fee_rate) AS avg_channel_fee_rate FROM channel_avgs), kept AS (SELECT c.avg_fee_rate, a.avg_channel_fee_rate FROM channel_avgs c JOIN overall_avg a ON a.avg_channel_fee_rate IS NOT NULL WHERE c.avg_fee_rate > a.avg_channel_fee_rate) SELECT AVG(avg_fee_rate), AVG(avg_fee_rate - avg_channel_fee_rate) FROM kept
